name: D7 Content Import
description: Import content exported from Drupal 7 sites.

suggests.drupal/webform: Enable the d7_import_webform submodule to import D7 webforms (Webform 7.x-4.x) as D11 Webform config entities.

project_description: D7 Content Import migrates content from a Drupal 7 site into Drupal 11 without the stepwise D7 to D8/9/10/11 core migration path. A bundled export script (d7_export_script/export_content.php) run under Drush on the source D7 site writes a set of XML files (taxonomy.xml, nodes.xml, files.xml, aliases.xml, menus.xml, and optionally webforms.xml). This module then reads those XML files, either through an admin form at /admin/content/d7-import or a set of Drush commands, and recreates vocabularies, taxonomy terms, content types and fields, file entities, nodes, URL aliases and menus. It preserves the original entity IDs (NID, TID, FID) by force-updating the base and field tables and then repairing the AUTO_INCREMENT counters so later inserts do not collide. Content types and fields are auto-created from the shape of the data: D7 field types are mapped to D11 equivalents, cardinality is inferred from observed deltas, list allowed_values are collected from usage, entity_reference target types and handlers are resolved, and every field is registered on the default form and view displays. An optional submodule, d7_import_webform, imports D7 Webform (7.x-4.x) forms as D11 Webform config entities. The whole toolset is administrative: the form route requires the 'administer site configuration' permission and the Drush commands run from the CLI.
